intro: Basketball is Lithuania's great passion, and the small country has long competed with the world's best.

chapters.title: Basketball
text: Lithuania won the European Championship in 1937, 1939 and 2003 and Olympic bronze in 1992, 1996 and 2000. Stars include Arvydas Sabonis and Šarūnas Marčiulionis.

chapters.title: Discus and swimming
text: Discus throwers Virgilijus Alekna and his son Mykolas are champions; Mykolas set the world record in 2024. Rūta Meilutytė won Olympic swimming gold aged 15 in 2012.

keyTerms.meaning: An athletics event where a heavy disc is thrown as far as possible.
